slices.summary: Adds the closed lifecycle vocabulary (mp-contracts lifecycle_notice.rs with strict flag MODEL_GATEWAY_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS, default false), three typed ChatEvent variants (retry_scheduled in the steps family; compaction and context_change as control events), the taxonomy regeneration, SPA handlers, AG-UI CUSTOM entries and the D1 ledger entry. Payloads are counts and closed tokens only; no proto, no migration.

slices.title: Retry visibility in both tool loops
slices.summary: Makes tool retries visible in the chat tool loop (retry_scheduled through a retry_sink on dispatch_audited_tool) and in the Do loop (OrchestrationEvent ToolRetryScheduled, tag 26, announced by execution-core and forwarded through session-core's orchestration broadcast). The reason is a closed token from transient_reason; error text never leaves the loop, and risky or non-retryable calls announce nothing.
